inj.note: Hargrave suffered a season-ending torn Achilles in last Sunday's win over the Bears, so this move is a mere formality. Green Bay's defense continues to be hit by injuries, as the unit awaits Micah Parsons' (knee) season debut. Chris McClellan and Anthony Campbell (ankle) will be next up for heavier snap loads up front on the defensive line.
inj.label: Out for season
